# Proposal

## Why
Characterize the existing summary rules with additional primitive status cases.
<!-- pdac:cite id="FR-SUMMARY-001" digest="sha256:d422a7f0e7294b9ffbb099871260c2ac5c287609036e808fc160786f294971ac" -->
<!-- pdac:cite id="BR-SUMMARY-001" digest="sha256:a21b966ff4747da8ee35ee1366ffeac16f6a6fa3da508ca04d3f0b31380677c4" -->

## What Changes
- Append numeric and boolean classification tests; preserve production code and all existing assertions.

## Capabilities
### New Capabilities
- `summary-characterization`: Verification of existing summary behavior.
### Modified Capabilities
None.

## Impact
Only src/summary.test.mjs and this plan. No product-model changes.

pdac-scope: cited
---

# Design

Use a frozen mixed inventory with exact literal expected counters, preserving scalar values, identity and nested contents.
<!-- pdac:cite id="FR-SUMMARY-001" digest="sha256:d422a7f0e7294b9ffbb099871260c2ac5c287609036e808fc160786f294971ac" -->
<!-- pdac:cite id="BR-SUMMARY-001" digest="sha256:a21b966ff4747da8ee35ee1366ffeac16f6a6fa3da508ca04d3f0b31380677c4" -->

Run the declared independent checks before review. Roll back only the added test and this plan.

# Tasks

The tests characterize existing rules.
<!-- pdac:cite id="FR-SUMMARY-001" digest="sha256:d422a7f0e7294b9ffbb099871260c2ac5c287609036e808fc160786f294971ac" -->

- [ ] 1.1 Append the numeric and boolean status matrix without changing existing assertions.
- [ ] 1.2 Run the declared checks and retain their results.

#### Scenario: Other primitive statuses
- **WHEN** numeric and boolean status observations are mixed with primitive passed and failed controls
- **THEN** only the two recognized controls are counted as passed or failed and all other statuses are unavailable
